rules.name: T3 Code
rules.summary: Sends product usage events (provider, model, reasoning effort, permission mode, turn results, durations, token counts, release channel) tied to hashed account or install identifiers to ingest.t3.codes, which forwards them to PostHog. Also sends relay connection traces to Axiom. Prompts, responses and file contents are not included. Stable and Nightly desktop builds share this bundle ID.

optOut.instructions: Set the environment variable T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false. The desktop app reads it from your shell profile (for example ~/.zshrc), so export it there and restart the app. For the t3 CLI or a server, set it in the server's environment before starting it. Opt-out of relay tracing also follows OTEL_SDK_DISABLED / T3CODE_OTEL_SDK_DISABLED. The browser web app and the mobile apps send their own connection traces that this variable does not control. Desktop builds from before 2026-11-16 ignored the variable for relay tracing (issue 37772), so update the app.

rules.name: Homebrew
rules.summary: Sends anonymous usage analytics to InfluxDB over HTTPS: formula and cask install events and build-error events. Events are kept for 365 days. A notice is shown before analytics are first enabled.

optOut.instructions: Run brew analytics off, or set HOMEBREW_NO_ANALYTICS=1. brew analytics state shows the current setting.

rules.name: Claude Code
rules.summary: Sends usage metrics (latency, reliability, usage patterns; no code, prompts or file paths) to Anthropic and third-party logging infrastructure. Sends error reports (stack traces, with redaction) to a third-party error tracker, on by default only for Pro, Max and Ultra sign-ins on v2.1.198 or later that connect directly to the Claude API. Metrics are off by default on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry.

optOut.instructions: Set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 to turn off metrics, error reports and surveys at once. Individually: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 turns off metrics, DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING=1 turns off error reports. These variables can also be put in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json.

rules.name: Next.js
rules.summary: Sends anonymous usage data: command invoked, Next.js version, general machine info (CPU count, OS, CI or not), detected plugins, build duration and page count, and Next.js MCP tool names with counts during development.

optOut.instructions: Run next telemetry disable in the project root, or set NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.

rules.name: Astro CLI
rules.summary: Sends anonymous usage data: command invoked, Astro version, machine info (CPU count, OS, CI) and configuration options in use.

optOut.instructions: Run astro telemetry disable (applies to the whole machine), or set ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.

rules.name: Nuxt
rules.summary: Nuxt asks for permission on first use and sends anonymous usage telemetry only if you agree. The prompt can be declined or the setting changed later.

optOut.instructions: If you accepted the first-run prompt, turn it off with npx @nuxt/telemetry disable (add -g for global), or set NUXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

rules.name: Turborepo
rules.summary: Vercel collects anonymous usage and host information about Turborepo commands. Collection is optional.

optOut.instructions: Set TURBO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in your shell profile. Running turbo telemetry disable also works, but App Checker cannot see that.

rules.name: Angular CLI
rules.summary: Sends command usage statistics to Google only if you explicitly opt in. The installer prompts once; declining or skipping the prompt means no data is collected.

optOut.instructions: If you opted in, run ng analytics disable (add --global for all projects). ng analytics info shows the current state; the on/off state is not checked by this app.

rules.name: Storybook
rules.summary: Sends anonymous usage data. Crash reports are a separate setting that is off by default. A content-free boot event is sent before the config file is read, so only the environment variable fully prevents telemetry.

optOut.instructions: Set core.disableTelemetry: true in .storybook/main.ts, pass --disable-telemetry, or set STORYBOOK_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true (the only option that also stops the early boot event).

rules.name: Gatsby CLI
rules.summary: Collects anonymous aggregate usage analytics. Users are notified on install and on first run.

optOut.instructions: Set GATSBY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in your shell profile. Running gatsby telemetry --disable also works, but App Checker cannot see that.

rules.name: Expo CLI
rules.summary: Collects anonymous usage data about general use of the Expo dev tools.

optOut.instructions: Set EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1.

rules.name: Vercel CLI
rules.summary: Collects usage telemetry: commands and options used, CLI version, general machine info (CPU count, OS, CI or not) and identifiers tied to your account. Environment variables, file paths, file contents, logs and serialized errors are not collected.

optOut.instructions: Set VERCEL_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 in your shell profile. Running vercel telemetry disable also works, but App Checker cannot see that.

rules.name: Netlify CLI
rules.summary: Collects data on usage of Netlify CLI commands to improve reliability and performance.

optOut.instructions: Run netlify --telemetry-disable, or set the telemetryDisabled property in the Netlify CLI config.json.

rules.name: Yarn (Berry)
rules.summary: Periodically sends anonymous usage data to Yarn's servers (for example number of dependencies and installs run). Never runs on CI. Default is enabled outside CI.

optOut.instructions: For one project run yarn config set enableTelemetry 0. For the whole machine run yarn config set --home enableTelemetry 0.

rules.name: Bun
rules.summary: Bun states it does not currently collect usage telemetry. Anonymous crash reports are sent by default and are controlled by the telemetry setting, which is equivalent to DO_NOT_TRACK. Collection of API usage and build timing is planned.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry = false in bunfig.toml, or set DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

rules.name: .NET SDK
rules.summary: Microsoft distributions of the .NET SDK collect usage data for .NET CLI commands (not for running an app with dotnet app.dll). The installer also sends one telemetry entry on successful install. A first-run notice explains this.

optOut.instructions: Set DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 (or true). To also stop the installer entry, set it before installing the SDK.

rules.name: Prisma CLI
rules.summary: Sends one anonymous event per prisma command, with a random installation ID and the Prisma version. Telemetry is on by default and off in CI. A first-run notice is printed.

optOut.instructions: Run npx prisma telemetry disable, or set PRISMA_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

rules.name: Go toolchain
rules.summary: By default Go telemetry counters stay on the local computer. Uploading an approved subset to telemetry.go.dev happens only after you run go telemetry on. Local collection can also be switched off.

optOut.instructions: If you opted in, run go telemetry local to stop uploads, or go telemetry off to also stop local collection.

rules.name: GitHub CLI
rules.summary: Since v2.91.0 sends pseudonymous usage telemetry to GitHub's internal analytics. GH_TELEMETRY=log prints the payload instead of sending it.

optOut.instructions: Run gh config set telemetry disabled, or set GH_TELEMETRY=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1. GH_TELEMETRY wins over DO_NOT_TRACK, which wins over the config value, so a GH_TELEMETRY that enables telemetry overrides the other two.

rules.name: Google Cloud CLI
rules.summary: Does not collect usage statistics unless you opt in during installation. Statistics exclude argument values and personal information.

optOut.instructions: If you opted in, run gcloud config set disable_usage_reporting true.

rules.name: AWS SAM CLI
rules.summary: Collects generic usage metrics, system and environment information (OS, runtime environment) and errors. No personal information such as user names or emails is collected.

optOut.instructions: Set SAM_CLI_TELEMETRY=0 in your shell profile (~/.zshrc).

rules.name: Azure CLI
rules.summary: Collects anonymous data on usage of the CLI and sends it to Microsoft. Collection is on by default.

optOut.instructions: Run az config set core.collect_telemetry=no. The on/off state is not checked by this app.

rules.name: k6
rules.summary: Sends a usage report each time k6 runs: anonymous installation ID, k6 version, OS and architecture, CI or not, and extension info when extensions are used.

optOut.instructions: Set K6_NO_USAGE_REPORT=true, pass --no-usage-report, or set noUsageReport in the config file.

rules.name: Flutter CLI
rules.summary: Sends anonymous feature usage statistics and crash reports to Google unless you have opted out. A review log is kept at ~/.dart-tool/dart-flutter-telemetry.log.

optOut.instructions: Run flutter --disable-analytics. flutter config shows the current setting.

rules.name: Visual Studio Code
rules.summary: Sends crash reports, error telemetry and usage data to Microsoft by default. The telemetry.telemetryLevel setting controls this: all, error, crash or off. Extensions may send their own data.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.telemetryLevel to off in Settings (Cmd+, then search telemetry).

rules.name: Docker Desktop
rules.summary: Sends diagnostics, crash reports and usage data to Docker. 'Send usage statistics' is enabled by default and Docker may periodically prompt for more information.

optOut.instructions: In Docker Desktop Settings, turn off 'Send usage statistics'. Administrators can set analyticsEnabled to false in admin-settings.json.

rules.name: Codex CLI (OpenAI)
rules.summary: Periodically sends a small amount of anonymous usage and health data to OpenAI (feature and configuration usage, model, auth mode). OpenTelemetry log export is separate and disabled by default.

optOut.instructions: Add [analytics] with enabled = false to ~/.codex/config.toml. Set otel.metrics_exporter = "none" to disable a custom OTLP metrics exporter as well.

rules.name: Firefox
rules.summary: Sends technical and interaction data to Mozilla by default, plus a separate Daily Usage Ping with de-identified information that Firefox is in use. Both can be turned off in settings.

optOut.instructions: In Firefox settings, clear 'Allow Firefox to send technical and interaction data to Mozilla'. The Daily Usage Ping is a separate opt-out in settings and is not affected by that checkbox. The on/off state is stored in a per-profile file, so this app does not check it.

rules.name: Google Chrome
rules.summary: Sends usage statistics and crash reports to Google by default. Crash reports may include site URLs and memory contents. Page URLs are shared only if 'Make searches and browsing better' is also on.

optOut.instructions: Open Chrome Settings > You and Google > Google services and turn off 'Help improve Chrome's features and performance'.

rules.name: Raspberry Pi Imager
rules.summary: Collects anonymous metrics by default: selected OS URL, category and name, Imager version, desktop or network installer, host OS version, architecture and locale. Stored only as aggregate counters.

optOut.instructions: Open App Options and untoggle 'Enable anonymous statistics (telemetry) collection', then Save.

rules.name: Zed
rules.summary: Sends diagnostics (crash reports and debug info, via Sentry) and anonymized usage metrics by default. Server-side data is collected when using Zed's hosted AI or collaboration services.

optOut.instructions: In settings.json set "telemetry": {"diagnostics": false, "metrics": false}. Both must be false to stop all client-side telemetry, so this app does not check the state.

rules.name: Aider
rules.summary: Analytics (LLMs used and token counts, no code, chat or keys) are collected only if you agree. A random subset of users is asked once whether to opt in.

optOut.instructions: If you opted in, run aider --analytics-disable once to disable analytics permanently.

rules.name: Gemini CLI
rules.summary: Sends usage statistics to Google. privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled defaults to true.

optOut.instructions: Set privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled to false in ~/.gemini/settings.json.

rules.name: Wrangler (Cloudflare)
rules.summary: Cloudflare gathers non-user-identifying usage telemetry about Wrangler commands. In the source, metrics are enabled by default unless the user, config or environment turns them off.

optOut.instructions: Run npx wrangler telemetry disable, set send_metrics=false in the project's wrangler.toml, or set WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

rules.name: Shopify CLI
rules.summary: Collects usage data by default: commands and flags run, timing, errors, and identifiers such as Shopify account ID, app API key and store domain.

optOut.instructions: Set SHOPIFY_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1 or OPT_OUT_INSTRUMENTATION=true.

rules.name: Python (VS Code extension)
rules.summary: Collects usage data and sends it to Microsoft. Honours VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel setting, which defaults to all.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.telemetryLevel to off in VS Code settings.

rules.name: Python Debugger (VS Code extension)
rules.summary: Collects usage data and sends it to Microsoft. Honours VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel setting, which defaults to all.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.telemetryLevel to off in VS Code settings.

rules.name: Docker (VS Code extension)
rules.summary: Collects usage data and sends it to Microsoft. Honours VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel setting, which defaults to all.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.telemetryLevel to off in VS Code settings.

rules.name: Container Tools (VS Code extension)
rules.summary: Collects usage data and sends it to Microsoft. Honours VS Code's telemetry.telemetryLevel setting, which defaults to all.

optOut.instructions: Set telemetry.telemetryLevel to off in VS Code settings.

rules.name: Red Hat YAML and XML (VS Code extensions)
rules.summary: Anonymous usage data is sent to Red Hat only after you accept the first-run opt-in prompt. No data is sent if telemetry.telemetryLevel is off, even when redhat.telemetry.enabled is true.

optOut.instructions: If you accepted, set redhat.telemetry.enabled to false in VS Code settings.

rules.name: Continue (VS Code extension)
rules.summary: Reports anonymous usage data to PostHog: suggestion accept or reject events, model and command names, token counts, OS and IDE name. Telemetry is enabled by default in the extension.

optOut.instructions: In the extension's user settings turn off 'Allow Anonymous Telemetry'.

rules.name: Terraform
rules.summary: Checks HashiCorp's Checkpoint service for updates and security bulletins and sends an anonymous ID.

optOut.instructions: Set CHECKPOINT_DISABLE in your shell profile, or put disable_checkpoint = true in ~/.terraformrc.
